thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high 429 rate for tenant 'holloway' in eu-west-1 VPC (holloway-dedicated-pool-2). 429 spike started ~2025-11-02T14:03:10Z. 5m error rate 21.8%. auto-escalation to oncall. dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/2956781234
ashwin.s: ack — taking this. paging SRE oncall now. I'll start triage and keep updates here.
megan.pm: pinging account team & customer success (Holloway) — notifying of possible degraded API for their users.
julio.eng: quick check — logs show surge of very short requests (~<20 tokens) from two API keys owned by holloway, sudden ramp at 14:02 UTC. Possibly a rollout on their side. sample log lines: `429 GET /v1/generate tenant=holloway key=ak_live_*** status=429 rps=310`
priya.sre: any token bucket/rl config changes recently?
ashwin.s: no config changes on our side. Querying routing & quota service now.
ashwin.s: ps: holloway is on Dedicated contract (reserved pool) with per-tenant fairshare limits + burst guard. Their pool is isolated but shared host hw.
ashwin.s: running `redwood infra quota show --tenant holloway --pool holloway-dedicated-pool-2` -> returns current fairshare=100rps, burst=200rps, current measured avg=280rps last 1m.
julio.eng: I can try a fast KV-cache eviction for that pool and move their traffic to standby nodes, but standby capacity is limited in eu-west-1.
ops-lead: @megan.pm can we do a temporary emergency lift? legal/billing aware? Need account buy-in for override.
megan.pm: account team on call — @account-bot confirmed manager is reachable. Holloway is requesting immediate relief; they're escalated internally. I can approve a short-term contract override (account exec level) for up to 60 minutes if SRE recommends.
priya.sre: mitigation options: 1) temporary quota bump (grace window) 2) divert % of traffic to a fallback pool in eu-central-1 (cross-region) 3) apply per-key throttling to most aggressive API keys 4) ask customer to rollback their rollout.
ashwin.s: recommended path: immediate temporary quota bump to 250rps for 30m + selective throttling for the 2 noisy API keys + spin up 2 extra nodes from burst reserve; if still high, divert 30% traffic to eu-central-1 fallback pool.
julio.eng: can implement throttle rule by key: `throttle_rule: { key: ak_live_abcd, max_rps:120 }` and add routing rule. I'll prepare the patch.
incident-bot: ACTION: create temp-quota request id=tmpq-2956781234 for tenant holloway pending approval.
megan.pm: approve tmpq-2956781234 for 30m now. please ensure we log start/end and bill appropriately. :white_check_mark:
ops-lead: ops approves node spin-up from reserved capacity. doing for 2 nodes in eu-west-1 now. ETA ~4m.
julio.eng: applying per-key throttle rules and the temporary quota bump. payload: ```json
{
  "grant": "temporary_quota",
  "tenant": "holloway",
  "duration_min": 30,
  "max_rps": 250,
  "note": "emergency lift approved by megan.pm tmpq-2956781234"
}
```
julio.eng: curl to config service: `curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/tenants/holloway/quota -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_API' -d @tmpq.json`
priya.sre: flushing pool KV cache for holloway-dedicated-pool-2: `redwood runtime cache flush --pool holloway-dedicated-pool-2`
ashwin.s: routing diversion rule prepped: 30% to eu-central-1 fallback pool holloway-fallback-1. Applying using blue/green traffic shift (10% -> 20% -> 30%).
incident-bot: update: node spin-up complete; 2 nodes added to pool holloway-dedicated-pool-2.
julio.eng: applied tmp quota and per-key throttles. monitoring.
priya.sre: immediate metrics: 429 rate fell to 6% within 90s, p95 latency steady. good sign.
megan.pm: customer reported improved success rate to their frontend teams. They will keep us posted, but want a formal window extension if needed.
ops-lead: leaving temporary quota scheduled to auto-revoke at +30m. If we need extension, must follow the contract override process (megan to sign).
ashwin.s: quick note: we saw a malformed retry loop from their mobile client spiking traffic; will include that in follow-up.
priya.sre: assigning post-incident actions: 1) owner @priya.sre for postmortem, 2) Julio to add per-tenant monitoring alert to catch noisy API key patterns, 3) Ashwin to coordinate billing & contract note, 4) Megan to coordinate customer comms.
account-bot: holloway manager acknowledged, asked for 1-hr postmortem and mitigation summary.
megan.pm: I'll schedule a 1-hour sync with Holloway Ops tomorrow.
ashwin.s: leaving this thread open for 45m for rollback/extension decision. If metrics are stable for 20m, we'll mark resolved.
incident-bot: note: tmpq-2956781234 will auto-revoke at 2025-11-02T14:33:34Z unless extended.
priya.sre: resolved->monitoring for now. will write postmortem later. :memo:\"
